about: DREAM-1 declined-topic stop (_core.topic_words, _core.same_topic, _core.topic_stopped). Run by plugins/av-events/tests/test_inference_run.py (the plugin, on _core) and scripts/tests/memory-signal-gate.test.ts (the gate, through plugin_core): both sides must give these results.
rule: words: loose_key tokens, minus the fixed stop words (English; Hindi and Hinglish, romanised and Devanagari; a few Tamil, Bengali and Arabic) and tokens with no letter; an ASCII plural of 4+ letters is folded: -sses/-ches/-shes/-xes/-zzes lose 'es', -ies of 5+ letters becomes -y, any other -s is dropped (not after ss, us, is). Known edge: a singular in -ie or -che ('movie', 'niche') folds apart from its plural. same topic: both sets non-empty and 2 x shared >= all (Jaccard >= 1/2). stopped: the candidate is the same topic as 2 or more declined suggestions.
